tagline: 雅西卡旁轴相机，1966 年发布
description: 雅西卡于1966年推出的旁轴相机。快门速度Copal SV leaf shutter from B to 1/500。感光度10–800。manual, with coupled rangefinder。

specs.快门: Copal SV leaf shutter from B to 1/500
specs.英文简介: Yashica replaced the selenium meter of the Yashica Lynx 1000 with a CdS cell when it introduced the Lynx 14 and Lynx 5000 in 1965.The standout feature of the Lynx 14 is a massive Yashinon 45mm F/1.4 lens, with a 58mm filter thread.
